title: EvaluatorPromotionEvaluateRequest
description: Body of POST /api/v1/analytics/runs/{run_id}/evaluator-promotion/evaluate. The server rejects unknown fields. An absent body is treated as an empty object, which fails validation because challenger_fingerprint is required.

challenger_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint (sha256 hex digest) of the evaluator version being judged for promotion.

incumbent_fingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the evaluator to beat. When null or omitted the server picks the most frequent non-challenger evaluator fingerprint among the run's outcome cells.

delta.description: Failure probability of each one-sided conservative bound; smaller is stricter. Exclusive bounds (0, 1).

min_pairs.description: Minimum number of shared anchor-backed pairs required to decide at all.
